_comment: Which compute unit each operator actually executes on, measured from msprof ArithmeticUtilization (aic_cube_ratio / aiv_vec_ratio). `aic_time=NA` means the kernel never launches a Cube block, i.e. it is pure Vector. `acceptance.py` uses this to pick the MFU denominator (Cube 378 / Vector 47 for bf16). Per-case msprof metadata overrides this map when present.

SharedExpertMLPFwdOp.evidence: gemm_basic_kernel GEMM dominates the call; AIC block active

MLADenseBwdOp.evidence: 2026-11-25 Cube redesign: msprof aic_cube_ratio 25.5% / aiv_vec_ratio 44.3%; 93 TFLOP/s > Vector peak 47 → the FLOPs execute on Cube (24.6% of 378).

MLAVarlenBwdOp.evidence: 2026-11-25 Cube redesign: msprof aic_cube_ratio 20.8% / aiv_vec_ratio 35.7%; 8x4k 71 TFLOP/s > Vector peak 47 → the FLOPs execute on Cube.

MoEPermuteAlignFwdOp.evidence: index copy only (manifest FLOPs=0); no AIC block
